operating_notes.text: Coal business segment revenue was nil in FY26 against ₹45.34 Cr in FY25; exploration of the Jharkhand coal block has commenced.
FY26 capex was ₹42.54 Cr, of which ₹5 Cr was intangible assets under development.
Trade receivables of ₹116.55 Cr at Mar-2026 exceeded Q4FY26 revenue of ₹77.70 Cr.
Order book at 31 March 2026 was ₹5,812 Mn, of which 73% was private-sector and 27% government.
FY26 segment mix: CBM Production 37.19% of revenue, Aquifer Mapping 24.93%, Non Coal Exploration 17.21%, Coal Exploration 15.96%; Coal Business was 0.10%.
Jharkhand coal block: 2.66 sq km, 84 MT estimated geological reserves, W-IV grade coal.
Currently executing 19 ongoing projects across multiple regions and exploration domains.
Secured three Letters of Award/Work Orders valuing over ₹22.68 Crores (including GST) from Odisha Lift Irrigation Corporation Ltd and Hindmetal Exploration Services Private Ltd.
Al Hadeetha Mining LLC (SWPE 17.5%) holds Block 22B in Oman under a Concession Agreement with the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, Sultanate of Oman.
Empanelled by Oil India Limited for 2D/3D seismic data acquisition across onshore acreages for a period of three years.
Secured exploration and drilling orders totaling ₹22.68 Cr including GST from CMPDI and Geomysore Services.

timeline.summary: South West Pinnacle Exploration submitted its annual promoter shareholding and zero-encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹77.7 Cr, net profit ₹13.05 Cr.
South West Pinnacle's May 2026 investor presentation reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,430 Mn (+34.8%), PAT of ₹330 Mn (+101.2%) and an order book of ₹5,812 Mn at 31 March 2026.
South West Pinnacle reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹243 Cr and PAT of ₹33 Cr, alongside a record order book of ₹581 Cr.
South West Pinnacle Exploration Ltd announced an earnings call on May 6, 2026, for audited financial results Q4FY26 and FY26, with recording available.
South West Pinnacle reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹78 Cr and PAT of ₹13 Cr, alongside a record FY26 revenue of ₹243 Cr.
South West Pinnacle secured exploration and drilling orders worth over ₹22.68 Cr from Odisha Lift Irrigation Corporation and Hindmetal Exploration.
Vikas Jain, Promoter, declared 68.85% promoter group shareholding (20,538,783 equity shares) in South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
South West Pinnacle executes shareholders' agreement for Oman JV Al Hadeetha Mining
South West Pinnacle Exploration secured a three-year empanelment from Oil India Limited for 2D/3D seismic data acquisition services across Indian onshore acreages.
South West Pinnacle Exploration received orders and work orders totaling ₹22.68 crores from CMPDI and Geomysore Services.
